description: This file defines a React functional component 'DeviceDetail' that displays detailed information about a device, including its status, and provides actions such as refresh, edit, delete, and ping. It manages state, handles API calls, and renders UI elements accordingly.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches device data from API and updates state.

methods.name: loadStatus
methods.description: Fetches device status from API and updates state.

methods.name: handlePing
methods.description: Triggers a ping to the device and updates status accordingly.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Opens confirmation dialog for device deletion.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Deletes the device via API and navigates away on success.
